services.desc: Matt and his helicopter service was outstanding. Went to Nova Scotia for a golf trip with my dad, brother, and best friend... and flew a couple of different days to various resorts. Matt's communication was excellent and [he] was a safe and expert pilot. We'll be back!! These guys are Pros!!! From booking to flight, couldn’t ask for a smoother process. Will definitely go back 👌 Thanks for the smooth trip gents 🙌 These guys are true professionals and I highly recommend their business to anyone. Cape Breton from the air is much different than the view from a car and these guys can give the best view while having the experience to back it up. Highly recommended. J.A. Douglas McCurdy Airport

services.desc: Breton Air offers comprehensive helicopter aerial work services, catering to diverse industries and applications. Our skilled pilots and versatile helicopters are equipped to handle a wide range of aerial work tasks, including power line inspections, pipeline surveys, environmental monitoring, aerial photography, and more. With our specialized equipment and expertise, we ensure precise and efficient execution of aerial work projects. services.name: Sunset Lobster Cruise

They offer bespoke excursions including world class golfing, fly fishing, and remote fly-in moose hunting. They operate predominantly out of Nova Scotia and Newfoundland & Labrador, supporting commercial and utility projects.
